english.note: Use 抵 as the all-purpose colloquial choice when something is worth doing or gives a fair return for the effort or cost.
Use 抵 as the everyday all-purpose way to say that something is worth what it costs.
Use this when stressing that the benefit or result is good value for the money or effort.

examples.english: This movie is so good that it’s worth paying a few dozen dollars for.
examples.traditional: 呢套戲咁好睇，畀幾十蚊都抵。
examples.jyutping: ni1 tou3 hei3 gam3 hou2 tai2 bei2 gei2 sap6 man1 dou1 dai2

examples.english: These movie tickets are so cheap and the movie is so good; they’re really cost-effective.
examples.traditional: 呢張戲飛咁平，套戲又咁正，真係抵。
examples.jyutping: ne1 zoeng1 hei3 fei1 gam3 peng4 tou3 hei3 jau6 gam3 zeng3 zan1 hai6 dai2

examples.english: Going on a trip at this price is really worthwhile.
examples.traditional: 呢個價錢去旅行真係抵。
